from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486287/attempts/1eb91fd6574841ae8e00d1bb94d07e69/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-b8788afd.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    centers = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if (grid[r][c] == 0 and grid[r-1][c] == 2 and grid[r+1][c] == 2
                    and grid[r][c-1] == 2 and grid[r][c+1] == 2):
                centers.append((r, c))
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(centers):
        for r2, c2 in centers[i+1:]:
            if r1 == r2 and abs(c1-c2) > 2:
                lo, hi = sorted((c1, c2))
                for c in range(lo + 2, hi - 1):
                    out[r1][c] = 1
            elif c1 == c2 and abs(r1-r2) > 2:
                lo, hi = sorted((r1, r2))
                for r in range(lo + 2, hi - 1):
                    out[r][c1] = 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path.read_text())
